_meta.indication: Treatment of patients with ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC who have progressed on or are intolerant to crizotinib (accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and duration of response)

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.phase: Phase 1, multicenter, open-label dose-escalation and expansion trial in patients with ALK-positive tumors; the efficacy cohort was drawn from patients treated at the 750 mg recommended dose (escalation and expansion phases)
pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, single-arm, open-label clinical trial; all patients received ZYKADIA 750 mg once daily
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with metastatic ALK-positive NSCLC who progressed on or were intolerant to crizotinib
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Objective response rate (ORR) according to RECIST v1.0, with duration of response
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 54.6% (95% CI 47, 62) by investigator and 43.6% (95% CI 36, 52) by BIRC; median duration of response 7.4 months (investigator) and 7.1 months (BIRC)

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥25%) are diarrhea, nausea, elevated transaminases, vomiting, abdominal pain, fatigue, decreased appetite, and constipation. In 255 patients: diarrhea 86%, nausea 80%, vomiting 60%, fatigue 52%. Serious warnings include ILD/pneumonitis (4%), QTc prolongation, hepatotoxicity, and hyperglycemia.
target_moa: Ceritinib is a kinase inhibitor; targets include ALK (most active), IGF-1R, InsR, and ROS1. It inhibits ALK autophosphorylation, ALK-mediated STAT3 phosphorylation, and proliferation of ALK-dependent cancer cells.

advisory_committee.vote: This NDA was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee for review.

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to full approval for ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC, verifying clinical benefit after crizotinib

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for the treatment of patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors are anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive as detected by an FDA-approved test, based on the results of Study CLDK378A2301, which verified the clinical benefit of Zykadia for the treatment of patients with anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)-positive, metastatic, NSCLC who have progressed on or are intolerant to crizotinib and fulfilled PMR 2146-1 cited in the April 29, 2014, approval letter for NDA 205755.

description.text: Changed approved dosage regimen from 750 mg fasted to 450 mg once daily with food

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application revises the currently approved dosage regimen of 750 mg orally once daily in the fasted state to 450 mg orally once daily with food and incorporates safety and pharmacokinetic data into the package insert and patient package insert.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Tumor response rate (ORR) and duration of response

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and duration of response *[see Clinical Studies (14)].* An improvement in survival or disease-related symptoms has not been established. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Conduct at least one multicenter, randomized clinical trial establishing superiority of ceritinib over standard therapy in adults with ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC previously treated with crizotinib or previously untreated (PMR 2146-1).

citations.quote: 2146-1 Conduct and submit the results of at least one multicenter, randomized clinical trial establishing the superiority of ceritinib over standard therapy in adult patients with ALK-rearranged (ALK-positive) metastatic NSCLC who have been previously treated with crizotinib or in adult patients with previously untreated ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC.

basis.text: Breakthrough Therapy Designation granted March 6, 2013 for ceritinib in ALK-positive NSCLC progressed on/intolerant to crizotinib, based on early evidence of clinical activity (ORR of long duration) and acceptable safety profile.

citations.quote: On March 6, 2013, Breakthrough Therapy Designation was granted for ceritinib for the treatment of (b)(4) ALK-positive NSCLC patients who have progressed on or are intolerant to (b)(4) crizotinib (b)(4) based on early evidence of clinical activity as demonstrated by ORR of long duration and an acceptable safety profile.

orphan_indication.text: Designated as an orphan drug on September 27, 2013 for treatment of non-small cell lung cancer that is ALK-positive.

citations.quote: September 27, 2013: ceritinib (identified as [5-Chloro-N2-[2-isopropoxy-5-methyl-4-(4-piperidinyl) phenyl]-N4-[2(isopropyl sulfonyl) phenyl]-2,4-pyrimidinediamine]) was designated as an orphan drug for the indication of treatment of non-small cell lung cancer that is anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK)- positive.

summary.text: Ceritinib received accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and duration of response from single-arm trial X2101, with a required confirmatory randomized trial. It had Breakthrough Therapy Designation (March 6, 2013), orphan drug designation (September 27, 2013), and was reviewed under priority review as an NME.

requirement.text: 2146-1: Conduct and submit results of at least one multicenter, randomized clinical trial establishing superiority of ceritinib over standard therapy in adults with ALK-positive metastatic NSCLC previously treated with crizotinib or previously untreated.

requirement.text: 2146-2: Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate systemic exposure and safety of 450 mg ceritinib with a meal and 600 mg with a light meal compared with 750 mg fasted in metastatic ALK-positive NSCLC patients.

citations.quote: 2146-2 Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the systemic exposure and safety of 450 mg Zykadia (ceritinib) taken with a meal and 600 mg Zykadia (ceritinib) taken with a light meal as compared with that of 750 mg Zykadia (ceritinib) taken in the fasted state in metastatic ALK-positive NSCLC patients.

requirement.text: 2146-3: Complete a pharmacokinetic trial to determine the appropriate dose of ceritinib in patients with hepatic impairment.

citations.quote: 2146-3 Complete a pharmacokinetic trial to determine the appropriate dose of Zykadia (ceritinib) in patients with hepatic impairment in accordance with the FDA Guidance for Industry entitled “Pharmacokinetics in Patients with Impaired Hepatic Function: Study Design, Data Analysis, and Impact on Dosing and Labeling.”

requirement.text: 2146-4: Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of ceritinib on the single-dose pharmacokinetics of midazolam (a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate).

requirement.text: 2146-5: Conduct a clinical trial to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of ceritinib on the single-dose pharmacokinetics of warfarin (a sensitive CYP2C9 substrate).
